Scholarships & Financial Aid
Tennessee Technological University has completely centralized all financial aid and
scholarships. Information on applying for financial aid and scholarships can be found
using Tennessee Tech's Financial Aid web site.
Financial Aid Office
There are a few scholarships administered by the Financial Aid Office that are offered
only to Mechanical Engineering Students. The table below shows only scholarships for
Mechanical Engineering students and the criteria you must meet to be considered for
one.
Scholarship Name
Eligibility
William Lowry Craig Memorial Scholarship amount varies
Must be a Maury County, Tenn., high school graduate - First preference given to Columbia
High School graduate, second preference to ROTC cadet
Must be ME Major
Must maintain a minimum 2.5 GPA
Hudy C. Hewitt, Jr. Mechanical Engineering Scholarship Endowment amount varies
Must be a sophomore, junior, or senior in ME
Must have a minimum 3.0 GPA
Must demonstrate financial need
Mechanical Engineering Scholarship Endowment (Brown) typically $1,000
Must be a junior ME major
Must be enrolled full-time
Must demonstrate good character
Must have best academic record within class or category
Must not have received other significant scholarships for the year
Factors such as financial need, expressed interest, and percentage of work done at
Tennessee Tech may be taken into consideration
Mechanical Engineering Scholarship Endowment (Masoud) typically $1,000
Must be an international student
Must be enrolled full-time
Must demonstrate good character
Must have best academic record within class or category
Must not have received other significant scholarships for the year
Factors such as financial need, expressed interest, and percentage of work done at
Tennessee Tech may be taken into consideration
Mechanical Engineering Scholarship Endowment (Wallace) typically $1,000
Must be a sophomore ME major
Must be enrolled full-time
Must demonstrate good character
Must have best academic record within class or category
Must not have received other significant scholarships for the year
Factors such as financial need, expressed interest, and percentage of work done at
Tennessee Tech may be taken into consideration
Mechanical Engineering Transfer Annual Scholarship typically $1,000
Must be a transfer student
Dr. Ed Griggs Engineering Scholarship Endowment amount varies
Must be a prospective or current student in good standing
Must be a sophomore, junior or senior enrolled in ME department
